Axiom: Every reconcile branch ends with evidence owned by that branch, never a generic duplicate tail: - ordinary execute supplies its per-ticket sync, phase gates, per-group audit, and code-review results; - a semantic spec-only change supplies the integrated review lifecycle's merged-publication proof; - a bounded direct metadata correction supplies `DIRECT_VERIFICATION_RECEIPT` for its frozen target-set and exact dedicated command. Missing or red evidence routes back to its owning flow. Never dispatch a second audit/code-review or claim an unexecuted bare tool name as verification.
